Privacy Policy

Effective date: November 12, 2026

Kall is an independently operated project. This policy covers the Kall landing page and early-access list.

What we collect and why

When you request early access, we save your email address and the time you signed up. We use this information to manage the list, contact you about Kall early access, and respond to your requests.

Our hosting and security providers may process technical request information, such as your IP address and browser details, to deliver, secure, and troubleshoot this site. When your browser loads Google Fonts, it sends a request directly to Google to display the site’s typefaces.

Who handles the information

OpenAI’s ChatGPT Sites hosts this page and may process information to provide the hosting service. Cloudflare helps deliver and protect the site. We may also disclose information when required by law.

Cookies and tracking

Cloudflare may set a bot-protection cookie named __cf_bm. Cloudflare says it expires after 30 minutes of continuous inactivity. The site does not include advertising pixels or analytics scripts, and it does not change its behavior in response to browser Do Not Track signals. The hosting, security, and font providers may receive the technical requests described above.

How long we keep your information

We keep your early-access entry while we need it to manage the list and contact you about early access. We remove it when you withdraw or when we no longer need it for those purposes, unless we must retain it by law.

Contact and privacy requests

To ask for a copy, correction, or deletion of your early-access information, or to leave the list, email widadeflo@icloud.com. If possible, write from the address you used to sign up so we can confirm the request.

Changes to this policy

We will update the effective date when this policy changes. For material changes, we will post a notice on the Kall landing page.
